location.name: Kazi Nazrul Islam Central Library
location.clue: The building full of books, named after the rebel poet.
A library carrying the name of the national poet.
Where the rebel poet's name guards a thousand silent pages.

location.name: Academic Buildings
location.clue: Where lectures and classes are held.
Rows of benches, a board and a long morning lecture.
Where attendance is taken and naps are attempted.

location.name: Administrative Buildings
location.clue: Where the university's official papers are handled.
Every certificate and notice begins its journey here.
The desk where a student's fate is stamped and signed.

location.name: Aparajita Hall
location.clue: The residential hall for girls.
Its name means the one who is never defeated.
A hall named for those who never lose.

location.name: Bijoy 24 Hall
location.clue: A residential hall named after a recent victory.
The year in its name remembers a great uprising.
A hall whose name is a victory and a year.

location.name: Khan Bahadur Ahsanullah Hall
location.clue: A residential hall for students.
A hall named after a famous educator with a long title.
A hall carrying a title of honour from colonial times.

location.name: Central Mosque
location.clue: A place of prayer on campus.
A calm place where the day is measured in prayers.
Five times a day, a call from here is heard across campus.

location.name: Central Temple
location.clue: A place of worship for Hindu students.
Bells and incense on a quiet corner of campus.
Where the evening arati lights a small corner of the campus.

location.name: Open Stage
location.clue: An open stage for events and performances.
Concerts and cultural shows happen under the open sky here.
No roof, no walls, only a stage and an audience.

location.name: Cafeteria
location.clue: Where students go to eat and drink tea.
Tea, snacks and the loudest conversations on campus.
Empty stomachs, full tables and the best gossip in town.

location.name: Medical Center
location.clue: Where sick students get checked by a doctor.
The first stop for fevers, cuts and headaches.
Where a white coat and a prescription pad wait for you.

location.name: Playground
location.clue: A big open field for sports.
Wide open grass where matches begin at sunset.
Eleven players, one ball and a crowd that never sits still.

location.name: Pond near Jibanananda Das Academic Building
location.clue: A pond in front of an academic building named after a poet.
A quiet pond facing the building of the poet of nature.
Water that mirrors the building of the poet who loved Bengal's rivers.
